channel.title: SE-Tools Changelog
channel.description: Update feed for SE-Tools. Version metadata and release notes only — the signed .zip stays in the private releases repo.

item.title: Version 3.26.0
item.description:
• Equinix brand look — The app follows the Equinix Brand Center: Nexa Text throughout, colours from the brand palette, and red text that stays readable on the dark background.
  • Official Equinix logo in PDFs — NRR, cage layout, Fabric and diagram PDFs carry the official logo instead of a typed name, and the Fortress keeps its ® mark.
  • PDFs in Nexa Text — Every PDF is set in Nexa Text with the font embedded, so it looks the same on any computer.
  • Mails in Arial — Mails use Arial and brand colours, as the brand asks for mail, so they look right in every inbox.
  • Drop-downs show the whole name — Drop-downs widen for a longer name instead of cutting it off, such as the rack type in the Cage Designer.

item.title: Version 3.25.0
item.description:
• Hot aisle cages — Choose Hot aisle when a layout is made: rows stand back to back on a concrete floor, with a chimney up to the ceiling. Cold aisle stays the default.
  • One currency in the PDF — Show every price in one currency you choose. Other currencies are converted at the ECB reference rate, and the PDF names its date.
  • Diagram without a white box — The diagram in the priced PDF sits on its card, with no white box behind the clouds.
  • No monthly total at the top — The design page's header no longer shows a monthly total. The sums stand under the bill.

item.title: Version 3.24.0
item.description:
• Renew your Equinix sign-in — When your Mac's Equinix sign-in has run out, your profile in the sidebar says so. One window renews it with your password, so directory search and photos work again.
  • Site Tour host from the directory — The host field suggests Equinix colleagues from the directory as you type.
  • Rename any project — Right-click a project to give it your own name. Leave it empty to go back to the automatic one.
  • Fast cage import at big sites — Importing a cage at a large site like FR2 no longer hangs. The cage list comes up quickly, and a second cage at the same site is there at once.
  • Tidier bundles — A click anywhere on a folded bundle opens it, and only one stays open. The filter counts show each bundle once, and in the bundle mail every project gets its own Equinix colour.
  • Cage Designer fixes — Imported racks are Equinix provided, and new racks continue VDC's numbering in their row. A single row gets its cold aisle in 3D, and rack numbers now show above trays and in the PDF.

item.title: Version 3.23.2
item.description: • NRR summary back in order — The quote cards of the NRR summary lay on top of each other; they're listed one under the other again. In the NRR mail, the patch panel settings no longer push the left column out of the window.

item.title: Version 3.23.1
item.description: • Smooth 3D, even on big cages — Turning and zooming the cage in 3D no longer rebuilds it, and selecting something only lights it up. Large cages with many racks and trays stay fluid.

item.title: Version 3.23.0
item.description:
• Select anything, move it together — In the Cage Designer, ⇧-click, a dragged frame or ⌘A take in racks, trays, doors, cameras, columns, notes and measurements. Drag or use the arrow keys to move them as one; duplicate, copy and delete work for every kind.
  • A tidier inspector — Every object shows its settings the same way: labelled rows, one hint, and Duplicate, Rotate and Delete in the same places. Straight or ring trays are picked there too.
  • Undo that keeps up — Undo keeps its history when you switch tools and takes back patch panels, tray sizes and cabinets too. Quick edits to different things stay separate steps.
  • Print and cleaner exports — ⌘P prints the layout. Exports leave out the check markers and show the grid labels as set, and a file that can't be written says why.
  • Safer layouts — One damaged item no longer costs the whole layout, a door that no longer fits its wall is flagged and can be moved, and importing over your own work asks first.
  • Quicker on big cages — Checks and camera views are worked out once per change, and dragging no longer redraws everything else.
  • Tour and menu — The tour now shows cameras and readers, and the Layout menu lists undo, copy, paste, import, add rows and print.

item.title: Version 3.22.4
item.description:
• Safer accounts — Your first sign-in and team requests now reach the admins through a separate, safer channel. They show up once an admin next opens SE Tools.
  • Cage Designer drop-downs — Rack type, rack size and door width use the same drop-down as the rest of the app, the type with its icon.

item.title: Version 3.22.0
item.description:
• CCTV cameras on the plan — Place cameras anywhere on the cage plan. Each shows what it sees, stopped by the walls, racks and columns; turn it by its handle. A check flags doors no camera covers.
  • A reader at every door — Every cage door gets a Suprema BioLite N2 fingerprint reader outside, right of the door – on the plan, in the layout PDF and in 3D. Switch it off per door.
  • Secure and Fortress in 3D — The 3D view and the PDF show the cage type from the Cage NRR: Secure walls reach the ceiling and down through the raised floor; Fortress walls are solid up to 2.4 m with mesh above.
  • Raised floor in 3D — The cage stands on a raised floor with 60 × 60 cm tiles on the plan's grid, cut open at the edge so the space below shows.
  • See what the cameras see — A Cameras switch in 3D shows each camera's view as a blue cone. The 3D switches now line up.
  • Leave a price out of a diagram — Take a product's price out of the diagram's bill without removing it from the drawing; it's listed below the total and can be brought back. The copy and the PDF follow.
  • Diagram fixes — A project's space no longer overwrites site 1's own label, and changing a link's bandwidth updates its price.

item.title: Version 3.20.0
item.description:
• Rows and new cages in the Cage Designer — Add whole rows in pairs across a cold aisle of ventilation plates, or start a new cage from its racks — it's drawn around them on the 60 cm grid.
  • Rack types, sizes and numbers — Mark racks as server, network, storage, GPU, ODF or in-row unit, and set width, depth and height. Racks are numbered per row (0101 …), and letters and numbers along the cage name every tile.
  • Aisle and door checks — The plan marks racks with too little room in front or behind, racks in a door's swing and racks outside the cage. Set the aisle widths or switch the checks off.
  • Duplicate, copy and paste — ⌘D puts a copy of the selected racks and plates beside them, off the ventilation plates; ⌘C and ⌘V copy and paste.
  • Obstacles and notes — Draw columns, CRACs or zones to keep free — racks can't stand there and the checks count them. Notes put short text on the plan; both show in the export.
  • Several custom parts in the Cage NRR — Add as many custom parts as needed, each with a description and its PDF. The NRR warns when a PDF is missing.
  • Better defaults in the Cage NRR — Air containment, access control and CCTV are on from the start, fiber 6in and copper 12in trays preselected. The racks step takes the rack count, width and CabE over from the Cage Designer.
  • Space types in the VDC Explorer — A new column shows Secure Cab, Secure Cab Express or Cage; filter by All · Cages · Cabinets. Cages are rows you can open, named IBX:floor:cage.
  • A disk image to pass on — Each release also comes as a disk image: open it and drag SE Tools to Applications — reliable when passed on over Teams or OneDrive.

item.title: Version 3.19.0
item.description:
• Your team's AE / SolEng Mapping — The mapping now shows your own team's AEs, SEs and SAs, and it's the same for everyone: changes reach every colleague at once instead of living on each Mac. Search and the AE field in a project use it too.
  • Ask to join a team — Not in a team yet? The AE / SolEng Mapping says so and lets you ask to join one — the admins are told right away.
  • Announcements — News such as a new price list or a change in process shows above the tools for a while. Close one with × and it stays closed.
  • Usage statistics, with a switch — SE Tools counts which tools you open and how many quotes and mails you make — never what's in them — and shares the counts with the admins once a day. Turn it off in Settings → Usage statistics; your shared counts are removed then.
  • Calmer motion — Copy confirmations come and go more quickly, results no longer wobble while you type, and large numbers keep their width. With Reduce Motion on, slides become gentle fades.
  • Clicks next to the sidebar — A click just right of the folded sidebar — e.g. on "7 days" — no longer opens a tool from the hidden part of the sidebar.

item.title: Version 3.18.2
item.description:
• Liquid Glass sidebar — The sidebar floats as a glass panel again, as in macOS's own apps: the tool's background runs underneath it, and the window buttons sit inside it with even space around them.
  • An even rhythm in the icon rail — Logo, rules and icons in the folded sidebar sit on one grid: centred, with the same space above and below every rule.

item.title: Version 3.18.1
item.description: • Test accounts without AD — An admin can give an account its own password in the permissions file — for demos and testing, without a directory account or the VPN. It shows in User Admin like anyone else and can be blocked there at any time.

item.title: Version 3.12.0
item.description: • Price lists are valid for one month — A price list now counts for the month it was imported in. From the 1st of the next month the Cage Calculator no longer prices from it and the NRR mail is locked, until the current list is imported — so no quote goes out on last month's prices. The chips and Settings show "Valid until" and flag expired lists in red.

item.title: Version 3.1.2
item.description:
• New app icon — official Equinix Dark-Purple/Maroon/Red gradient and hex-grid texture, with a white Fortress glyph. Reads clearly at Dock size instead of blurring into a dark square.
  • The welcome screen now advances on its own after 2 seconds instead of waiting for a "Get started" click.
